scope: LABSCN-002 inventory of all productive demos in the active demo catalog

classificationModel.B: container suitable with resource and tolerance contract

orchestrationModel.MANUAL: The participant or trainer starts understandable T-SQL scripts in one or more SQL client sessions.
orchestrationModel.RUNNER_ASSISTED: A project-specific runner maintains timing, loops or parallel activity while the workload and observation remain represented by T-SQL.
orchestrationModel.AUTOMATED_VERIFY: The scenario is executed, asserted and cleaned up automatically for smoke and regression quality assurance.

scenarios.title: Blocking Chain
scenarios.forcedCondition: Open transactions acquire deterministic locks and named database signals order dependent sessions until an observable blocking chain exists.
scenarios.synchronization: Manual execution exposes the causal session sequence; FWK-006 named signals provide deterministic automated verification. Launch delays are process-start hints only.
evidence: runtime matrix validates Docker and Podman on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025
problem manifest executes HEAD, MIDDLE, LEAF and OBSERVER
TSQL_SCENARIO_ORCHESTRATION selects the smallest sufficient orchestration level
knownLimits: RUNNER_ASSISTED may be added later for a continuously maintained blocking state but is not required for the first teaching slice

scenarios.title: SARGability
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent predicates run against deterministic indexed data in seek-compatible and non-SARGable forms.
evidence: runtime matrix validates Docker and Podman on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Statistics Anatomy
scenarios.forcedCondition: A fixed data distribution and explicitly generated statistics create a known histogram and density state.
evidence: runtime matrix validates Docker and Podman on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Controlled Spill
scenarios.forcedCondition: A controlled cardinality and memory-grant mismatch produces spill evidence under a defined resource profile.
knownLimits: spill characteristics may vary by build and adaptive-feature state; assertions test evidence rather than exact spill volume
evidence: runtime matrix validates a fresh instance on Docker and Podman for SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Plan Properties
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic out-of-range statistics state produces plan-wide and operator-level evidence before and after targeted statistics maintenance.
evidence: runtime matrix and current status report repeated validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Rebinds, Rewinds and Performance Spool
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic correlated access pattern produces observable outer references, rebinds, rewinds and an optimizer-selected performance spool with a controlled contrast.
evidence: runtime matrix and current status report repeated validation on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025

scenarios.title: Catch-all, OPTION RECOMPILE and parameterized dynamic SQL
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic skewed data set and controlled compilation order contrast catch-all predicates, recompilation and safely parameterized dynamic SQL.
evidence: Actions run 33222989681 validates two complete runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025; WARN_EMPIRICAL_VARIANCE is an expected truth-preserving outcome and cleanup passed.

scenarios.title: Neutral client and session context
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equivalent query text executes under explicitly controlled session SET options and client-independent connection settings.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 30699410795 validates two Docker-based runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025; the demo, runner and workflow are unchanged at the current repository commit.

scenarios.title: Sampling, Skew and Histogram Boundaries
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic hot-key distribution is represented by sampled and fullscan statistics.
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Ascending Key and Statistics Maintenance
scenarios.forcedCondition: Deterministic values are inserted beyond the last materialized statistics boundary.
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Deterministic Deadlock Cycle
scenarios.forcedCondition: Two signalled actors acquire row locks in opposite order and form a bounded deadlock cycle.
scenarios.synchronization: Named FWK-006 signals establish lock ownership before the conflicting accesses.
knownLimits: system_health graph visibility is optional evidence
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.
LABSCN-005 validates the SQL Server 2025 Project Adapter lifecycle on Docker run 76cff6ed-a714-44e6-beda-6b916600cb98 and Podman run 6d2d0a51-1915-4e65-a380-baec715fc676.

scenarios.title: TempDB Cost Classes
scenarios.forcedCondition: Bounded temp objects and grouping work expose separate user, internal and version-store counters.
knownLimits: instance configuration and SQL Server 2025 governance are deferred
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Page Splits, Density and Fragmentation
scenarios.forcedCondition: Gap inserts run against equal tables with fill factor 100 and 80.
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Columnstore Segments and Rowgroup Quality
scenarios.forcedCondition: Ordered and deterministically shuffled classic CCI loads create different segment overlap.
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: VLF Structure and Planned Log Growth
scenarios.forcedCondition: A bounded transaction grows a marker-owned log with a one-megabyte growth step.
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Commit Batching and WRITELOG
scenarios.forcedCondition: Equal rows are written with one commit per row and one bounded batch commit.
knownLimits: instance wait delta can contain concurrent work
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Wait Scope and Time-Bounded Deltas
scenarios.forcedCondition: A signalled row lock exposes current task and request waits during a bounded server-delta window.
scenarios.synchronization: Named signals bind blocker, waiter and observer before the lock is released.
knownLimits: ASYNC_NETWORK_IO requires a separately paced client
evidence: Actions run 33222989644 validates two PASS runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Parameter Sensitive Plan Optimization
scenarios.forcedCondition: A deterministic skewed distribution contrasts one reused plan with an eligible PSP dispatcher and query variants.
knownLimits: SQL Server 2019 returns SKIP_VERSION; variant formation remains eligibility-bound
evidence: Actions run 30701731564 validates SQL Server 2022 and 2025; SQL Server 2019 returns the expected SKIP_VERSION in two runs.

scenarios.title: Optional Parameter Plan Optimization
scenarios.forcedCondition: An optional equality predicate contrasts a single plan with an eligible OPPO dispatcher and NULL-state variants.
knownLimits: SQL Server 2019 and 2022 return SKIP_VERSION; variant formation remains eligibility-bound
evidence: Actions run 30702590969 validates SQL Server 2025; SQL Server 2019 and 2022 return the expected SKIP_VERSION in two runs.

scenarios.title: Parallel Plan Areas and Thread Work
scenarios.forcedCondition: A bounded amplified workload crosses the parallel threshold and exposes exchange operators, actual DOP and per-thread work with a MAXDOP 1 counterprobe.
knownLimits: The contract proves plan and thread evidence, not a universal DOP or performance recommendation.
evidence: Actions run 33447840232 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Query Store History
scenarios.forcedCondition: A marker-owned database records bounded Query Store plan, runtime and wait history for a deterministic query family.
knownLimits: Query Store collection is asynchronous; assertions use bounded retries and evidence presence rather than exact timing values.
evidence: Actions run 33222989682 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.

scenarios.title: Bounded Extended Events Evidence
scenarios.forcedCondition: A marker-filtered, memory-bounded Extended Events session captures a deterministic statement and is removed by the same lifecycle.
knownLimits: The event session is server-scoped; therefore an isolated disposable instance is mandatory.
evidence: Actions run 33222989682 validates two PASS/OK runs on SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.
